annotations.title: Gemini Neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) Expressive Voice Synthesizer

description: Converts written text into natural, prosody-controlled spoken voice audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash Neural Text-to-Speech. Use when rendering voiceover narration or spoken agent replies from a deterministic text script; for conducting bidirectional conversational audio dialog comprehension, use process_live_audio_dialogue instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('voice_persona' defaults to 'neutral_broadcast'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

text.description: Exact written script or paragraph to synthesize into spoken voice audio.

voice_persona.description: Expressive vocal timbre preset; defaults to 'neutral_broadcast' when omitted.

name: synthesize_gemini_speech_audio

output.description: Synthesized speech audio descriptor and phoneme duration summary.

title: Gemini Neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) Expressive Voice Synthesizer
